objective: provide local cartoon avatars for user forms without changing the existing upload contract

requirements.statement: show eight local cartoon avatars in a reusable picker
convert a selected default avatar to a PNG File and preserve existing upload behavior
keep manual image upload available with existing validation
remain usable on desktop and narrow mobile layouts

design.assets: eight project-local 128x128 PNG illustrations under web/public/avatars
design.interaction: popover gallery with selected state, accessible labels and upload fallback
design.persistence: selected PNG is emitted as File and sent through existing /system/users/{id}/avatar endpoint
design.security: no external image URLs and no relaxation of backend avatar MIME/size validation
